description: Portable DAO review certificate vectors. Canonical bytes are encoding/json output of the Go structs: declared field order, no insignificant whitespace, HTML-safe escaping. Signatures are Ed25519 over domain + NUL + canonical JSON of the signed body. Certificates are verified with an independently trusted review hash and the verification time; expect=accept means every rule passes.

vectors.name: two-of-three-approvals-accepted
vectors.description: Two distinct approvals meet the threshold; one rejection is ignored for quorum but not hidden from the roster.

vectors.name: accepted-after-deadline-before-expiry
vectors.description: Decisions made before the deadline still form a valid certificate after the deadline and before expiry.

vectors.name: three-approvals-accepted
vectors.description: More approvals than the threshold are accepted and listed in canonical pin order.

vectors.name: wrong-expected-review-hash
vectors.description: The trusted expected review hash differs from the signed manifest hash.

vectors.name: malformed-expected-review-hash
vectors.description: The expected hash uses uppercase hex, so it is not a canonical sha256 commitment.

vectors.name: certificate-at-expiry
vectors.description: Verification at the exact expiry instant is rejected.

vectors.name: certificate-before-creation
vectors.description: Verification before the review's creation time is rejected.

vectors.name: one-approval-below-threshold
vectors.description: A single approval does not satisfy a two-of-three threshold.

vectors.name: duplicate-reviewer-approval
vectors.description: The same reviewer key approves twice, which must not count as two votes.

vectors.name: rejection-listed-as-approval
vectors.description: A signed rejection appears in the approvals list.

vectors.name: noncanonical-approval-order
vectors.description: Two valid approvals are in reverse pin order instead of canonical order.

vectors.name: outsider-approval
vectors.description: A validly signed approval from a key outside the pinned roster is rejected.

vectors.name: approval-at-deadline
vectors.description: A decision timestamped exactly at the deadline is outside the review window.

vectors.name: future-approval
vectors.description: A decision timestamped after the verification time is rejected.

vectors.name: tampered-approval-signature
vectors.description: One byte of an approval signature is changed while the review hash remains correct.

vectors.name: tampered-manifest-epoch
vectors.description: The manifest epoch changed without re-signing; the expected hash is the tampered manifest's own hash.

vectors.name: signed-minority-threshold
vectors.description: The coordinator correctly signs a minority threshold; verifiers must still enforce a strict majority.

vectors.name: wrong-certificate-domain
vectors.description: The certificate domain is not the v1 certificate domain.

vectors.name: unknown-field
vectors.description: An unknown top-level field is rejected by the strict decoder.

vectors.name: duplicate-key
vectors.description: A duplicate top-level version key is rejected rather than last-value-wins.

vectors.name: null-version
vectors.description: A null version is rejected instead of being treated as absent.

vectors.name: trailing-json-value
vectors.description: A second JSON value after the certificate is rejected.
